properties.name: sbp.auth.port
properties.description: HTTP port for the auth service. Overridden by env AUTH_PORT.

properties.name: sbp.internal-api.base-path
properties.description: Reserved base path for internal auth APIs.

properties.name: sbp.auth.datasource.host
properties.description: PostgreSQL host. Overridden by env AUTH_DB_HOST.

properties.name: sbp.auth.datasource.port
properties.description: PostgreSQL port. Overridden by env AUTH_DB_PORT.

properties.name: sbp.auth.datasource.name
properties.description: PostgreSQL database name. Overridden by env AUTH_DB_NAME.

properties.name: sbp.auth.datasource.username
properties.description: PostgreSQL user. Overridden by env AUTH_DB_USERNAME.

properties.name: sbp.auth.datasource.password
properties.description: PostgreSQL password. Overridden by env AUTH_DB_PASSWORD.

properties.name: server.servlet.context-path
properties.description: Public API base path for auth.
